name: Contract clause checker
description: Answer questions about our contract library and flag clauses that differ from our standard terms, quoting the page each one came from.

name: Weekly blog digest
description: Every Friday, summarise the week's posts from our product blog and email the digest to the team.

name: Invoices to a sheet
description: When an invoice arrives by email, read the PDF, pull out the supplier, number, date and total, and add a row to our invoices sheet.

name: Meeting notes to Slack
description: When a meeting recording is uploaded, transcribe it, write a summary with decisions and action items, and post it to Slack.

name: Mentions triage
description: Every hour, check new Bluesky mentions, sort them into praise, questions and complaints, and send complaints to our Discord support channel.

name: Weekly product promos
description: Every Monday, take our three newest Shopify products, make a short promo video for each with a voiceover, cut it for Reels, TikTok, Shorts and LinkedIn with captions, write the post text, and post once I approve in Slack.

name: Larkspur support agent
description: A support chat agent that answers from these documents and can look up invoices through our API.

name: Support inbox replies
description: Reply to emails sent to support@ using our help center and policies. Send simple answers automatically; ask me in Slack before sending anything about refunds or complaints. Log everything in a sheet.

name: Product launch in three languages
description: When we publish a new product in Shopify, translate its description into Spanish and German and ask me before posting it to Telegram.

name: Travel policy assistant
description: A travel policy assistant that answers from our policy and hands anything above the limits to a person.
